turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you holding up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've got way too much stuff for the new place. It's half the size.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's common when downsizing. Would you rather sell the extra furniture, or donate it and get it out quickly?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Excuse me for a moment, my friend has a question. Don't talk until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey Leo, what are you reading at the moment?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: A history book about lighthouses. It's surprisingly gripping.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Seriously, there's shipwrecks, storms, keepers going mad from loneliness.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that does sound good. Can I borrow it when you're done?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sure, give me a week or so.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, I'm back now. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. Have you thought about the furniture that won't fit?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sell the good pieces, donate the rest.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Best of both. Take photos this week so you have time to find buyers.
